name: TypingMind
summary: Chat interface for several LLM providers that runs on your own API keys, sold as a one-time licence.
description: TypingMind is a chat front end for models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and other providers. Users connect their own API keys and pay providers per use, while TypingMind itself is sold as a lifetime licence. Features include plugins, MCP support, prompt libraries, document upload and voice input, depending on tier. Licences start at $39 for Standard, with Extended and Premium tiers costing more.
